basic_info.description: Shown by Appointment only.  Enter through a gracious formal foyer and be instantly captivated by sweeping views of the Presidio, Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz, and the Bay framed perfectly from every window. This rarely available NW corner residence combines the timeless elegance of 1920s architecture with sophisticated modern updates. The airy, open layout is enriched by classic details throughout. A chef's kitchen features marble countertops with a breakfast bar, Subzero refrigerator, Viking gas range, wine fridge, and abundant storage, plus a full-size laundry room. Entertain in the expansive dining room or unwind in the living room beside a gas fireplace, set against a breathtaking Golden Gate backdrop. The serene primary suite offers bay views and a spa-inspired bath with a double vanity and steam shower with dual heads. A well-appointed guest bedroom and bath complete the home. Private storage and a large garage space included. The building offers a stunning stained-glass lobby and a 24-hour on-site resident manager. Located just one block from Union Street's premier shops and dining, with easy access to Fillmore, Chestnut, and the Marina. 100 Walk Score. Elegant, refined living with iconic views in one of San Francisco's most coveted buildings.
